name: Twisted Memories
source:
Twisted Memories is a game about an ugly bastard that travels back in time and turns into his teenage self.
What will an ordinary looking teenager with the mind of a perverted old man be able to do?
How many of the woman from his past will he be able to corrupt?
Will he build the harem he always dreamed about, or will he maybe find the true love he was always missing in his life?
The choice is yours.​
translation:
《扭曲的回憶》講述一個猥瑣醜男穿越回過去，變回自己少年時代模樣的故事。

一個長相平凡、腦子裡卻裝著好色老男人心思的少年，究竟能做出什麼事？他能讓過去結識的多少女人隨他一起墮落？他會建成一直夢想的後宮，還是會找到生命裡始終缺少的真愛？

選擇在你。
